How do I arrange a visit?+

Call (631) 223-9278 to ask about appointments and today’s availability. Walk-ins are welcome.

Do you offer kids’ haircuts?+

Yes. Generations offers kids’ haircuts, with children’s haircut chairs featured in the shop’s own photographs.

Where is the shop?+

Find us at 200C East Montauk Highway in Lindenhurst, NY 11757. Open directions before you head over.

What are your hours and prices?+

Call the shop for current hours and pricing. Availability can change, so it’s best to confirm directly before your visit.
